title: A cloud start or resume installs from main, never from a checkout's old branch
why: Incident (coordinator, Nov 1 00:14 CDT): at the 00:11 resume, the session-start install (with #915's code) took /home/user/claude-settings as its source while it sat on the merged session branch claude/loving-curie-27u5bl at 7c76fc61, 102 commits behind main. It logged 'WARN ... on branch ...; left as is' and still installed settings, hooks and CLAUDE.md from that branch: 2 merge allow rules where main has 4. Every cloud session's own checkout can sit on a session branch, so any resume can install old guards. It breaks the reason of decision merge-reinstalls-from-main: links that follow a checked-out branch put unreviewed or stale hooks live.
note: Triage judged it a debt with an incident (roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes): it hits every resume of a session whose checkout is on a branch. No owner question: the fix restores what merge-reinstalls-from-main already protects. Fix in install.sh's cloud block, one home: when the session checkout is on a branch, or holds a commit main lacks, or is dirty, the install still takes its files from origin/main (for example a detached worktree or the cloud mirror at origin/main) and leaves the checkout as it is; a branch whose head main already holds may simply move to main. The lane writes debt record cloud-install-from-branch and closes it with the fix. Done check: a cloud-setup test with the checkout on an old merged branch, and one on a branch with unmerged commits, both install main's hooks and allow rules (4 merge rules), red on main and green on the fix; the checkout's own branch and changes are untouched. Needs no answer. Starts after step cloud-merge-moves-pin (same install.sh block), or rides in that lane if the coordinator gives it the brief. Files: install.sh, hooks/test_cloud_setup.sh, hooks/test_install_src.sh.
